name: 斑海豹决策
description: 本地斑海豹决策模型连接器：为 WorkBuddy 提供文档分类、审批预判、任务路由、质量 gate 四类结构化决策能力，模型服务不可用时 fail-closed 降级。
description_zh: 本地斑海豹决策模型连接器：为 WorkBuddy 提供文档分类、审批预判、任务路由、质量 gate 四类结构化决策能力，模型服务不可用时 fail-closed 降级。
description_en: Local Phocinae decision-model connector providing four structured decision capabilities for WorkBuddy: document classification, approval prediction, task routing, and quality gate, with fail-closed fallback when the model service is unavailable.
examples_zh: 把这批发票按类别归档，并给出置信度
预判这份报销单能否批准，给出风险等级
判断这个任务该路由给哪个专家执行
对这份 PPT 做交付前质量检查
examples_en: Classify these invoices by category with confidence scores
Predict whether this expense claim should be approved and its risk level
Route this task to the right expert for execution
Run a pre-delivery quality check on this deck
